eps.o: Doozie tours the doghouse and the many places to play, then meets puppy friends and designs cool T-shirts for their stylish pal Seaquin's fashion show.
Part snort, part giggle, entirely adorable! Puggie has lost his silly snortle, but Doozie's on the case while playing puppy doctor in the doghouse.
Bow-wow meets meow, meow! Older sis Gabby and her kitty pals stop by the doghouse for a day of puppy-cat playdates to the farm, under the sea and more.
Yummy Zone, Puppy Patch, Game Zone? Doozie and her crew need to find the perfect place in the doghouse for a basketful of cute hamster puppies.
Get your glow on! Join Doozie, Puggie and Seaquin for a special ride on PixiePup's glittering glow cruise in the doghouse's Puppy Patch.
With cool glasses and an awesome gadget, Doozie and Puggie drop into the doghouse as puppy agents to solve problems and save CreamPup, GamePup and pals.
It's the most magical day of the year! Pixie grants wishes to the pups in the doghouse and gets help from Doozie when she runs out of magic.
